newsitems.title: Ebbtide добавили в список желаемого Steam 100 тысяч раз всего за три дня
newsitems.contents: Разработчик Ebbtide поделился впечатляющим результатом: всего за три дня после появления игры в Steam пользователи добавили её в список желаемого 100 000 раз. Особенно примечательно, что Ebbtide разрабатывает всего один человек. Несмотря на это, проект уже привлёк огромное внимание игроков, а сам разработчик признался, что не ожидал такого интереса за столь короткое время. Автор поблагодарил всех, кто добавил игру в желаемое и рассказал о ней другим. По его словам, поддержка мотивирует продолжать работу над проектом. Сейчас разработчик улучшает игровой процесс, в котором предстоит принимать решения на оперативной карте и лично участвовать в сражениях. Также в планах создание масштабного режима-песочницы на карте мира, который позволит выйти за пределы Лос-Анджелеса, управлять флотом и бороться за оставшиеся безопасные зоны по всему миру. Дата выхода и цена Ebbtide пока не объявлены. Игра разрабатывается на Unity 6 для ПК и macOS. В будущем автор планирует провести тестирование, а затем выпустить общедоступную демоверсию.

newsitems.title: 100,000 wishlists in 3 days! Thank you + FAQ
newsitems.author: Son
newsitems.contents: https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/46616839/d4d45bc5cd864ba94857c40551230ae384082f47.gif Thanks to all of you, Ebbtide has reached 100,000 wishlists in just 3 days. Honestly, I never expected so much interest so quickly, and it still feels hard to believe. Seeing a game I have been making on my own reach so many people is incredible. I will draw on your support as motivation to work even harder on the game. To everyone who discovered Ebbtide, added it to their wishlist, or told others about it: thank you. There is still so much I want to show you and so much to refine. I want the game to live up to your expectations. I will keep refining the gameplay, from the decisions you make on the operations map to the moments you take control and fight on the battlefield. I am also working on a world-map sandbox that will take the game beyond Los Angeles and across the globe. Over time, I will share more of how you can protect the remaining safe zones around the world, move your fleet, and decide for yourself where and how to fight. Step by step, I will keep building toward the day you can play Ebbtide yourselves. Thank you for being part of this. Frequently asked questions Here are some of the questions that come up often on Discord and in the community. When is the playtest? I am preparing a playtest. I will share the dates and details on how to join on Steam and Discord when it is ready. What are the release date and price? The release date and price have not been decided yet. I will share another update with you soon. Which platforms is the game coming to? Ebbtide is being developed for release on Steam for Windows and macOS. Steam Deck support is also being considered. Will there be multiplayer or co-op? Development is currently focused on the single-player experience. Co-op is being considered for a post-launch update, but I cannot promise support yet. It is a feature I would personally love to add! Will there be cities beyond Los Angeles? The tutorial and Chapter 1 take place in Los Angeles. After that, I plan to expand to other cities around the world through a world-map sandbox. Will there be a demo? I plan to run the Steam Playtest first, followed by a public demo. The exact schedule has not been decided yet. Steam and Discord will be the first places I share the details when they are ready. Will there be mod or Steam Workshop support? Yes, I plan to support mods and Steam Workshop. The scope and approach will be decided and shared as development progresses. Which engine are you using? Ebbtide is being developed with Unity 6 and C#. Will the game launch in Early Access? I have not decided yet. I will share an update here once that decision is made. Which languages will be supported? English and Korean are the base languages. I plan to expand support to the other 17 languages listed on the Steam page with help from community translations. Additional planned languages: French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Arabic, Czech, Indonesian, Polish, Romanian, Thai, and Turkish. How can I share feedback or contribute to development? Feel free to share your thoughts on Discord. If you would like to contribute voice recordings or translations, please check the information channels on Discord. Will there be gamepad support? I am working on gamepad support. Will the game come to consoles? For now, I am focused on PC development for Steam. What are the minimum system requirements? Minimum and recommended system requirements will be shared on the Steam page before launch. Your questions and feedback help a great deal with development. Thank you again for being part of this. Join the Ebbtide Discord

newsitems.title: 15,000 wishlists. Thank you!
newsitems.author: Son
newsitems.contents: Hello, I’m the developer behind Ebbtide. Ebbtide has reached 15,000 wishlists. I never expected this much interest. To everyone who has been following development, and everyone who has just discovered the game, thank you so much. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46616839/895d77c00f442272e0395bb95ebd52813062a775.gif Ebbtide is a survival strategy game about staying alive in a world overrun by zombies. Command your forces on the operations map, dive into the battlefield to fight yourself. build forward operating bases, and hold back the hordes with support from land, sea, and air. From now on, I’ll keep sharing development updates here. I’ll show you new units and battlefields, along with what’s changing. When a playtest is ready, you’ll hear about it here first. AI use and the work ahead At first, I tried to make every part of Ebbtide myself. I used AI to help with assets I couldn’t manage on my own. I want to be specific about where I used it. As mentioned on the Steam page, I used AI in creating the soundtrack, some prerecorded voice lines, sound effects and ambient audio, event illustrations, and in creating or refining some 3D models. I also used AI to help translate the in-game text. No content is generated with AI during gameplay. Without that help, it would have been difficult to bring Ebbtide to where it is today on my own. I’ve reviewed and refined this work to make it fit naturally into the game, but there are still areas that need improvement, particularly the voices and translations. Then I opened the Discord server. At first, I was overwhelmed by all the interest and messages, but the people who helped manage the community made it possible for me to keep up. I’m sincerely grateful to the admin team for all their help. Talking with so many of you has made me more aware of the limits of what I can do alone. At the same time, it has opened up possibilities I hadn’t considered. Some of you offered to help directly, and one of them suggested a way for the community to take part in making the game. So I’d like to start by reworking voice recording and localization. Together with contributors, I’ll work on improving awkward voices and wording, one piece at a time. If the opportunity arises, I’d also like to collaborate with musicians on a new soundtrack. There’s still a lot for me to learn and improve. As development continues, I’ll keep listening to your feedback and sharing the changes here. Join the conversation I’m looking for people who would like to contribute voice recordings or translations to the game. If you’re interested, or would simply like to share your thoughts about Ebbtide, please join us on Discord. Join the Ebbtide Discord Simply following development and sharing your feedback already helps a great deal. Thank you again for wishlisting Ebbtide. I’ll keep working, step by step, toward the day you can play it yourselves.

newsitems.title: Анонсирована Ebbtide, стратегия о выживании в мире зомби
newsitems.contents: Анонсирована Ebbtide, стратегия в реальном времени, в которой игрокам предстоит возглавить военные силы человечества и сдерживать нашествие зомби. События начнутся в охваченном хаосом Лос-Анджелесе. Игрокам предстоит командовать пехотой, танками и авиацией, эвакуировать выживших, сопровождать конвои и строить передовые базы. Одной из особенностей игры станет возможность переключаться между стратегической картой и трёхмерным полем боя, а также брать под прямое управление отдельных солдат и технику. Ebbtide выйдет на PC в Steam. Дата релиза пока не объявлена.
